source_facts.statement: New Call pending switch sends IsPending true; ignores scheduled-time and recipient required rules, not other field/custom-field rules; success routes to Pending Calls.
Pending Dispatch opens a picker initialized from proposed recipients. Explicit picked list replaces the stored list; empty pick can fall back to stored proposed recipients.
Scheduled list Dispatch now calls confirmDispatchNow (no picker); the hook dispatches with no replacement list, using stored recipients. Both current list and details use this behavior.
Web confirmations use window.confirm; native uses Alert. Capture actual platform confirmation instead of inventing common custom-modal controls.
Cancel pending invokes CloseCall with Cancelled and refreshes pending list; it is not DeleteCall.

Reschedule entry appears in scheduled waiting-call details menu, not as a list-row reschedule control. The sheet offers three presets and department-local formatted input; successful submit refetches queues and closes it.

Current client references GetCallYears, GetArchivedCalls and SaveArchivedCall; no matching action-name text exists anywhere under checked Core Web.Services/Controllers. This source mismatch is consistent with prior archived404, not new runtime verification.

Command-map passes onPress=handleMapPress; the retained isolated MapViewProps/destructuring omits onPress forwarding. Its ShapeSource click handler is separate. No drawn annotation success is currently accepted.

Dispatch handleRecenterMap consumes client location-store latitude/longitude, not a department or incident-center parameter; it does nothing without those values. Do not request real GPS for this recording.
IC queue source implements status/actions, but held43 is Online/empty with disabled controls; it does not prove any offline event or replay.
